title: FAIRGRPO: FAIR REINFORCEMENT LEARNING FOR EQUITABLE CLINICAL REASONING

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing clinical diagnostic performance metrics (Accuracy, F1 score, True Positive Rate, False Positive Rate, False Discovery Rate) and computing disparity metrics like Equal Opportunity Difference (EOD) and Predictive Parity (PP) between male and female patient records.

Evaluating and comparing clinical diagnostic performance metrics (Accuracy, F1 score, True Positive Rate, False Positive Rate, False Discovery Rate) and computing disparity metrics like Equal Opportunity Difference (EOD) and Predictive Parity (PP) across four distinct age groups (18-25, 26-50, 51-75, 76+).
